verdict.rationale: Financial Connections is a bank-data API that provides balances, ownership and transactions, so an insights feature is a fair question for it. The only AI-related evidence is a use-case row, 'Financial insights for agents', in which external agents run spending analysis through the Link CLI, plus a general Stripe MCP server. Both are building blocks that let a user's own agent analyze the data; neither shows the product itself generating insights or suggestions inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
